description: This file defines a PHP class 'nusoap_fault' used for representing SOAP faults, including methods for serialization. It also includes a backward-compatible alias class 'soap_fault'. The file is part of a SOAP client/server library within a larger PHP project.

classes.name: nusoap_fault
classes.description: Contains information for a SOAP fault, including code, actor, string, and detail; provides serialization to XML.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes fault properties with provided values.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the SOAP fault object into an XML string for transmission.
